========================================================================
JG-LGL-006 · REFUND & CANCELLATION POLICY (रिफन्ड तथा रद्द गर्ने नीति)
Policy · v1.1 · Updated 12 Apr 2026 · Applies to: Customers & providers
========================================================================

This policy sets the refund and cancellation rules across services,
course enrollments and marketplace products on Junetara Glam. Refunds
are always issued to the original payment gateway (eSewa, Khalti or
Fonepay).

1. SERVICE BOOKINGS
Free cancellation 24+ hours before the slot. Within 24 hours: 50%
refund. Customer no-show: no refund. Provider no-show: 100% refund plus
NPR 200 platform credit.

2. COURSE ENROLLMENTS
Full refund before the course start date. Pro-rated refund within the
first 14 days of attendance. Opened training kits are non-refundable.

3. MARKETPLACE PRODUCTS
7-day returns on unopened items; 14-day replacement on defects. Refunds
process within 48 hours to 7 days through the original gateway.

4. PROMO CODES & DISCOUNTS
Codes are not refundable. On partial refunds, discounts are retained
proportionally.

5. DISPUTES
Raise a dispute within 48 hours of the transaction from My Space. The
platform mediates within 3 working days; unresolved matters proceed to
NEPCA arbitration, Kathmandu.

6. GATEWAY FAILURES
Failed but debited transactions auto-reverse within 72 hours. Contact
support with the transaction ID for expedited handling.
